statement: Game-pass evidence is archived locally, outside the working tree, one archive per pass. This ledger records names, sizes and SHA-256 digests only - never captured content - so it can be tracked without redistributing anything. Verify an archive with `check`, not `verify`: the manifest travels inside the archive and cannot detect its own rewrite.
